headline_item.title_zh: 英伟达董事会否决黄仁勋复职计划
headline_item.title_en: On Q3 earnings call, Nvidia Chair Harvey Jones says the board does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO (Hayden Field/The Verge)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 英伟达现任董事长Harvey Jones正式否决前CEO黄仁勋的复职诉求，并将继续推进针对其个人行为的内部调查
headline_item.event_summary_en: Nvidia Board Chair Harvey Jones stated in the quarterly earnings call that the board unanimously rejects former CEO Jensen Huang's reinstatement request, as the internal investigation into his personal conduct and alleged links to Chinese intelligence assets continues. Despite Huang's public efforts to return and support from political figures, the board maintains his removal to mitigate escalating regulatory and compliance risks following his resignation on November 12th.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Harvey Jones（英伟达董事会主席）、黄仁勋（英伟达前CEO）在英伟达季度财报会议：董事会明确拒绝复职请求，并将继续内部调查与国会听证准备
【起因与机理】因涉及员工丑闻及与中国情报资产疑似关联的严重合规与国家安全调查
【核心事实细节】英伟达董事会正式否决黄仁勋复职诉求。
【涉及范围与推进】后续焦点集中在12月1日的国会听证会及潜在的政党腐败调查。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Harvey Jones (Nvidia Board Chair), Jensen Huang (Former CEO) (Nvidia Q3 Earnings Call): Rejection of reinstatement, continuation of internal investigation, and preparations for Congressional hearings
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Serious compliance and national security concerns regarding personal conduct and alleged ties to foreign intelligence
[Key Position & Outlook] Focus shifts to December 1st Congressional testimony and potential political corruption inquiries.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 英伟达果断切割创始人体现了头部科技企业在面对地缘政治审查与监管合规风暴时的生存逻辑：即通过剥离高风险个人标签，防止公司整体经营牌照陷入被动。此举不仅是企业治理的防卫性动作，更是为了安抚华尔街并应对即将到来的国会听证，实质上是在国家安全议题与商业连续性之间进行的惨烈止损。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: Nvidia's swift dissociation from its founder highlights a survival strategy for Big Tech amid geopolitical scrutiny: purging high-risk individuals to preserve operational licenses and mitigate systemic regulatory fallout. This defensive governance move is a calculated effort to appease capital markets and prepare for Congressional oversight, prioritizing institutional stability over founder-centric continuity.

headlines.title_zh: AI作为情感伴侣：人际关系的异化与重塑
headlines.event_summary_zh: 生成式AI在亲密关系中的深度渗透引发临床心理学关注，其作为“情感辅助工具”的双刃剑效应显著
headlines.event_summary_en: As generative AI's conversational capabilities advance, it is rapidly transitioning from a task assistant to an emotional companion, introducing risks of alienation in personal relationships. Clinicians and legal experts observe that AI, due to its infinite patience and vast knowledge, is increasingly used for marital advice and emotional catharsis, though it also triggers concerns regarding social withdrawal and dependency.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】临床心理学家Shira Sobol Goldberg、家庭律师Benny Don-Yehia：AI介入婚姻沟通与情感排解过程，作为辅助工具的双重属性显现
【起因与机理】AI模型提供的信息获取便利性与全天候陪伴能力导致用户情感投射转移
【核心事实细节】AI由工具转向情感补偿与沟通中介角色。
【各方立场与态度】AI在家庭法律和情感治疗领域表现出双刃剑特征。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Clinical psychologist Shira Sobol Goldberg, Family lawyer Benny Don-Yehia: AI integration into marital communication and emotional regulation
[Root Cause & Mechanism] AI's 24/7 availability and knowledge accessibility shift user emotional investment
[Key Metrics] com and the Kinsey Institute found that 61% of singles considered falling in love with an AI or sexting with a chatbot to be cheating.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Dual-natured impact of AI in family law and therapy.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: AI深度介入私人情感领域揭示了技术的“情绪杠杆效应”：当算法能够提供即时反馈与共情模拟时，人类处理真实复杂关系的人格韧性正在被弱化。这预示着未来AI辅助软件将形成新的垂直产业，但也需要面对极其严峻的心理成瘾与社会原子化失控的监管道德挑战。
headlines.industry_impact_en: The integration of AI into private emotional spheres reveals a 'psychological leverage effect': as algorithms provide instant feedback and empathy simulations, the resilience required for navigating complex human relationships is being eroded. This suggests an emerging vertical for AI companionship software, while simultaneously posing severe ethical risks regarding addiction and societal atomization.

headlines.title_zh: 英伟达发布第三季度财报，营收同比翻倍至1158亿美元
headlines.title_en: Nvidia’s Q3 earnings hit the mark, without mentioning the whole Jensen Huang thing
headlines.event_summary_zh: 英伟达临时首席执行官柯莱特·克雷斯宣布第三季度营收达1158亿美元，净利润创下653亿美元的纪录
headlines.event_summary_en: NVIDIA Interim CEO and CFO Colette Kress reported Q3 revenue of $115.8 billion, a 103% year-over-year increase, with data center revenue contributing $107.6 billion. The report confirms the successful launch of the Vera Rubin architecture and adherence to the established product roadmap.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】柯莱特·克雷斯（英伟达临时CEO兼CFO）在英伟达2024财年第三季度财报沟通会：营收1158亿美元，数据中心营收1076亿美元，净利润653亿美元
【起因与机理】AI算力基建需求持续高增长及高性能计算平台市场渗透率提升
【关键数据与实测】核心财务表现：季度营收1158亿美元，净利润653亿美元。
【各方立场与态度】战略部署：Vera Rubin架构正式投入市场，产品路线图维持既定节奏。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Colette Kress (Interim CEO and CFO of NVIDIA) (NVIDIA Q3 Earnings Call): Revenue of $115.8B, Data Center revenue of $107.6B, Net profit of $65.3B
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Sustained high demand for AI computing infrastructure and market penetration of high-performance platforms
[Key Metrics] Financial Performance: $115.8B quarterly revenue with $65.3B net profit.
[Key Position & Outlook] Strategic Roadmap: Vera Rubin architecture rollout confirmed with steady execution.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 数据中心营收占比超过92%，显示公司已完全转型为算力基础设施供应商，单纯的GPU销售逻辑已让位于整个AI集群系统的交付能力。Vera Rubin架构的快速量产标志着其在先进制程封测领域的供应链整合进入收割期，正进一步拉大与定制化ASIC厂商的架构生态护城河。
headlines.industry_impact_en: With data center revenue accounting for over 92% of total income, NVIDIA has fully transitioned into a core infrastructure provider, prioritizing full-stack AI cluster delivery over individual GPU sales. The rapid rollout of the Vera Rubin architecture signals a peak in their advanced packaging supply chain integration, further widening the ecosystem moat against custom ASIC competitors.
